messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE P0 — Cache coherency glitch detected. Multiple tenants showing intermittent stale reads and elevated read error rates. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/cache-coherency — paging oncall

oncall-alex: oncall Alex here, looking. tagging SRE and runtime. who has impact list?

sre-jasmin: Joining. Pulling logs and telemetry now. which path is regressing — prefetch, kv cache, or routing?

support-oliver: Support sees a spike of customer reports from tenant:acme-inc and tenant:fluxlabs. Symptoms: stale data on brief windows (~30-90s) and occasional 503s. Raising priority on comms.

eng-runtime-lee: quick triage — trace shows inconsistent prefix population from prefetch worker during high fanout. Some KV reads returning older snapshots when prefetch and live write ordering overlap. Suspect prefetch race. Recommend: 1) disable prefetch_v2 on affected clusters, 2) apply per-tenant read quota caps to slow down fanout, 3) route heavy traffic to cold-read path (safer correctness).

oncall-alex: Agree. Execute mitigations in that order. Keep canary off until stable. Jasmin, can you take the runtime toggle and quota changes? I'll handle customer comms.

sre-jasmin: On it. Disabling prefetch for us-east-1 cluster now. Command I'm running:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://ops-api.internal/config \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"feature":"prefetch_v2","state":"off","scope":"cluster:us-east-1","reason":"live-coherency-mitigation"}'
```

sre-jasmin: prefetch_v2 toggle returned 200. Action logged.

eng-runtime-lee: I'll push a lightweight rate-limiter rule for high-fanout tenants. Example rule (applied to tenant:acme-inc and tenant:fluxlabs):

```json
{"tenant":"acme-inc","read_qps":200,"burst":50}
```

sre-jasmin: Applied quota patch for tenant:acme-inc and tenant:fluxlabs. Policy ID: rl-20260317-03. Throttles in effect. Adding temporary 429 mapping and alert if throttled > 0.5% of requests.

support-oliver: Status page updated and customers notified: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3187654321. CS draft posted in #customer-notify for review.

product-emma: Good. Please capture exact traffic patterns, prefetch logs, and a snapshot of KV versions for RCA. We'll schedule a postmortem and regression test to prevent reintroducing prefetch without safety checks.

oncall-alex: Handoff: I'm handing the incident to Jasmin for observation and follow-up. I'm available for escalations. Jasmin, you'll take oncall for the next 2 hours? :white_check_mark:

sre-jasmin: Taking it. Monitoring dashboards (cache_coherency_errors, read_latencies, prefetch_throughput). Will escalate if error rate > 2% sustained for 5m or if new tenants appear impacted.

incident-bot: ACTIONS: prefetch_v2 disabled (us-east-1), rate-limit rules applied for 2 tenants, customer notifications published. Monitoring set to heightened.

sre-jasmin: Early signs: error rate trending down, stale-read window reduced. Keeping quotas in place for now, will re-evaluate in 1h and run deeper trace.

support-oliver: Customers acknowledge mitigation, some report immediate improvement. Keeping watch for regressions and collecting logs per tenant.

oncall-alex: Thanks team — good quick coordination. Please add timeline and all commands to the incident doc. I'll join postmortem. :thumbsup:

product-emma: Adding follow-up items: test harness for prefetch race, automated gating on prefetch rollout, and snippet-level assertions for prefix reads.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigations deployed, monitoring OK. Next update due in 30m or on escalation.
